tagline: Combine multiple PDF files into one document, right in your browser
pageDescription: Combine multiple PDF files into a single document with this free online Merge PDF tool. Drag and drop your files, reorder them so the pages come out in the right sequence, then merge with one click. Everything runs locally in your browser — your files are never uploaded to a server, so even confidential documents stay private. No signup, no watermarks, and no file-size paywall.

instructions.title: How to merge PDF files

steps.title: Upload your PDFs
steps.description: Drag and drop two or more PDF files onto the upload area, or click to browse and select them.

steps.title: Reorder the files
steps.description: Use the up and down arrows to set the order — the final document is assembled from top to bottom.

steps.title: Remove anything extra
steps.description: Click the × on any file you added by mistake before merging.

steps.title: Merge into one PDF
steps.description: Click Merge PDFs. The combine happens instantly in your browser — nothing is uploaded.

steps.title: Download the result
steps.description: Download the single merged PDF containing all pages in your chosen order.

features: Combine unlimited PDF files into one document
Numbered list so the merge order is always clear
100% client-side — files never leave your browser
No file-size limits, watermarks or signup
Works offline once the page has loaded
Instant download of the merged PDF
useCases: Combine multiple invoices or receipts into one PDF
Merge scanned pages into a single document
Assemble a contract from separate signed sections
Join chapters or reports into one file
Combine bank statements for an application
Put a cover letter and CV into one PDF
proTips: Reorder files before merging — the final order matches the list top to bottom
The number badge shows each file's position in the final document
Because everything is local, you can safely merge confidential PDFs
Add files in several drops — they append to the existing list
Merge PDFs without Adobe Acrobat or any installed software — it all runs online
Large PDFs merge fastest on desktop browsers
Need to split instead? Use the Split PDF tool
troubleshooting: Merge button disabled: add at least two PDF files
Wrong page order: use the arrows to reorder before merging
A file won't add: make sure it is a real PDF, not a renamed file
Encrypted PDF issues: password-protected files may fail to load
Huge output file: merging many scanned PDFs produces a large file — that's expected

keyboardShortcuts.description: Drop PDF files onto the upload area
